verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only permission controls: allow/ask/deny rules, approval prompts and a --dangerously-skip-permissions bypass. These are approval gating, not sandbox isolation of code, tool or network execution. No container, VM, filesystem or network isolation is documented, so this adjacent control earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources
